::: {.home-intro}
I'm a bioinformatician with over 10 years of experience in immunology and tuberculosis research. I've worked on everything from wet-lab assay development to clinical study coordination and data pipelines.

This site is my data portfolio: exploratory analyses of public health data, RNA-seq differential expression, biomarker studies and end-to-end pipelines on Databricks with MLflow. It also has practical tutorials in R and Python, the peer-reviewed research I've contributed to, and articles I've written on reproducible science.
